PenyPost simulates real-world postal travel! Letter delivery time is calculated based on geographic distance between countries. A letter sent across oceans takes a few hours to arrive, bringing back the heartwarming anticipation of real slow mail.
Pick a penpal, choose a cozy paper, and introduce yourself from the heart! Share your daily life, hobbies, or local culture — genuine stories build deep, lasting bonds.
Make your letters unique with custom paper templates, aesthetic typography, handwritten doodles, and stickers. Tap the canvas tools while composing to express yourself.
Take your time writing long and heartfelt letters. Your work is automatically saved as a draft so you can always pick up right where you left off.
Every letter you send uses one stamp from your collection. Claim daily free stamps or collect unique regional and themed stamps to complete your Stamp Album.
Browse the PenPals tab and filter by continent, language, and shared interests to discover wonderful friends with common hobbies from across the globe.
Showcase your favorite received letters and beautiful envelopes on your public profile. You can easily toggle showcase visibility anytime from your profile or letter viewer.
In Profile Settings, set your preferred daily letter delivery hour so incoming letters arrive during your favorite cozy reading time.
Signing in protects your penpals, letter archives, drafts, and stamp collections so everything stays safe even when switching devices.
Protect your privacy. Never share your exact home address, phone numbers, or passwords. If you ever receive inappropriate letters, you can block or report the user immediately.
Why does my envelope look softer sometimes?

To preserve your stamp, sticker, and paper design exactly as you made them, we capture your envelope as an image when you hit Send. On some lower-end devices, that snapshot can come out a little softer than what you saw while decorating — that\'s expected, not a bug, and your letter still sends just fine.
